evals.name: node-trust-comunica
evals.prompt: I just turned on HTTPS for my Community Solid Server Pod using mkcert. curl works fine without -k, my browser is happy, but when I run a Node.js script that uses Comunica to do SPARQL federation against the Pod, it throws `UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT_LOCALLY`. The CA is definitely in Keychain — `security find-certificate -c 'mkcert development CA'` finds it. What's going on and how do I fix it without disabling cert validation? I run Comunica in a Docker sibling container if that matters.
evals.expected_output: Identify root cause: Node.js doesn't read macOS Keychain (uses bundled OpenSSL trust). Fix: NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS env var pointing at $(mkcert -CAROOT)/rootCA.pem, set in shell AND in the Docker container env (since Comunica runs in a sibling container). Should NOT recommend rejectUnauthorized: false or NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 as the primary fix.
